name: ownership
description: The sense that you are the decision-maker for large or complex system, so that many of your specific actions are driven by the goal of making sure the entire system operates successfully.
perceptions: I need to make sure this system operates appropriately.
If I don't stay involved with all the details, there will be consequences.

guidance.description: Six Ways You Can Demonstrate Ownership To Show Leadership
10 Tips for Being a Better Homeowner

variations.name: responsibility
variations.description: The sense that specific actions or decisions are driven by reaching a worthy goal. This goal may be set internally, another person, or a group.
perceptions: I'm constrained in certain actions and decisions by an agreement.
There may be consequences if I don't comply.
I've greed to carry out this goal.

guidance.description: Taking Responsibility for Your Actions: 15 Ways to Cultivate Accountability
10 Ways To Become More Mature & Responsible

examples: Most families and jobs require individuals to accept specific tasks they might not choose to do themselves.

commentaries.quote: One way to think of about 'ownership' is that you've subordinated your short-term pleasure-seeking self to a longer term goal.
You cannot escape the responsibility of tomorrow by evading it today.
No man should bring children into the world who is unwilling to persevere to the end in their nature and education.
Prioritize your problems and take care of them one at a time, the highest priority first. Don’t try to do everything at once or you won’t be successful.
commentaries.attribution: Jocko Willink in Extreme Ownership: How U.S. Navy SEALs Lead and Win

commentaries.quote: Taking complete ownership of your outcomes by holding no one but yourself responsible for them is the most powerful thing you can do to drive your success.

Freedom makes a huge requirement of every human being. With freedom comes responsibility. For the person who is unwilling to grow up, the person who does not want to carry his own weight, this is a frightening prospect.
